notes.title: New version is available 1.1.11
notes.notes:
Hello,

There is, a new version is available 1.1.11

- Level 48 fixed (because many players have problem :P)
- Intro/ending button added (You can watch intro/ending over and over :D)
- Fixed some bugs
- Performance improvements (low-end)
- Updated for Windows 32 and 64 bit, Linux 32* and 64 bit*, MAC 64 bit
- Other minor issues

* Linux will be updated tomorrow

Changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1564760/discussions/0/4830646290527545820/

notes.title: Update coming soon
notes.notes: I'll be updating the game soon. I will add 12 or 24 new levels and improve some things. I don't know if there are any bugs, players haven't reported (only some exploit thanks to @Pooky). Today I played a game and it's OK. But if there are any problems please let me know.
